# 当前数据库字段字典

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync_contract_index.py from cumulative forward migrations. -->

共 **92 张业务表**；不含 Flyway 元数据表。迁移为 V001__baseline.sql、V002__agent_workspace.sql、V003__runtime_integrity.sql、V004__tutor_runtime.sql、V005__content_workbench.sql、V006__interactive_learning.sql、V007__identity_operations.sql、V008__compiler_learning.sql、V009__artifact_files.sql、V010__study_workflow.sql、V011__private_assets.sql、V012__evaluation_workbench.sql、V013__text_and_notebook_interactions.sql、V014__batch_ingestion.sql、V015__learning_context_checkpoints.sql、V016__personal_courseware.sql、V017__courseware_study_runs.sql。

这是累积到当前版本的唯一字段字典。已发布迁移不可修改或删除；新增字段使用下一条前向迁移。UUID 为 CHAR(36)，哈希为 SHA-256，时间由服务按 UTC 写入。跨表归属、完整来源闭包、语义正确性仍由服务和事务验证，不能仅凭外键判断。

具体事务、审核、撤回与运行规则见 [数据与一致性](../docs/03-data.md)。

## app_user — 用户身份与角色

创建于 `V001__baseline.sql`。

| 字段 | SQL 定义 | 用途 | 引入迁移 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | UUID主键 | `V001__baseline.sql` |
| `username` | `VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL` | 规范化小写登录名 | `V001__baseline.sql` |
| `password_hash` | `VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL` | 自适应散列；禁止明文 | `V001__baseline.sql` |
| `roles` | `JSON NOT NULL` | 服务端控制的角色列表 | `V001__baseline.sql` |
| `status` | `VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'` | ACTIVE或DISABLED | `V001__baseline.sql` |
| `created_at` | `DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)` | UTC创建时间 | `V001__baseline.sql` |
| `display_name` | `VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` | 用户可编辑昵称；不作为登录或权限标识 | `V007__identity_operations.sql` |
| `profile_revision` | `INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` | 资料乐观锁版本 | `V007__identity_operations.sql` |
| `auth_epoch` | `BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` | 改密和关闭账户递增；旧认证不得创建新会话 | `V007__identity_operations.sql` |
| `closed_at` | `DATETIME(3) NULL` | 主动关闭UTC；保留不可变历史而非宣称物理擦除 | `V007__identity_operations.sql` |

约束与索引：

```sql
PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE (username)
CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','DISABLED'))
```

| `spent_tokens` | `BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` | 已结算token | `V002__agent_workspace.sql` |
| `deadline_at` | `DATETIME(3) NOT NULL` | 运行截止UTC | `V002__agent_workspace.sql` |
| `created_at` | `DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)` | UTC | `V002__agent_workspace.sql` |

约束与索引：

```sql
PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE (workspace_id,id)
UNIQUE (trigger_event_id)
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id,goal_id) REFERENCES learning_goal(workspace_id,id)
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES context_snapshot(workspace_id,id)
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id,trigger_event_id) REFERENCES workspace_event(workspace_id,id)
CHECK (plan_revision > 0 AND run_epoch > 0 AND token_budget > 0)
CHECK (reserved_tokens >= 0 AND spent_tokens >= 0 AND spent_tokens <= token_budget - reserved_tokens)
CHECK (budget_micros > 0 AND reserved_micros >= 0 AND spent_micros >= 0 AND spent_micros <= budget_micros - reserved_micros)
CHECK (status IN ('PLANNING','QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_USER','PAUSED','COMPLETED','PARTIAL','FAILED','CANCELLED'))
INDEX ix_run_schedule (status,deadline_at)
```


## tutor_request_runtime — 持久导师请求的租约取消来源与计量状态

创建于 `V004__tutor_runtime.sql`。

| 字段 | SQL 定义 | 用途 | 引入迁移 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | 对应原始tutor_request；持久恢复主键 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `workspace_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | 请求所属本人工作空间 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `snapshot_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | 用户明确选定的不可变上下文快照；每次准入与返回复检 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `mode` | `VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL` | EVIDENCE_ONLY确定性证据整理或MODEL显式外部模型 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `request_epoch` | `BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` | 取消、过期及重新领取时递增的结果写入栅栏 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `lease_token` | `CHAR(36) NULL` | 本次领取随机令牌；过期不可提交，取消后仅可对账同次已派发用量 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `lease_until` | `DATETIME(3) NULL` | 当前工作租约UTC截止时间；终态清空 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `deadline_at` | `DATETIME(3) NOT NULL` | 含排队时间的请求绝对UTC截止时间 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `attempt_count` | `INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` | 仅未派发外部调用的安全领取次数；最多3次 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `input_hash` | `CHAR(64) NOT NULL` | 规范化请求参数SHA256；与幂等键共同防请求内容混淆 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `context_hash` | `CHAR(64) NOT NULL` | 创建时固定快照的规范化内容hash；不复制私人记忆正文 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `evidence_refs` | `JSON NOT NULL` | 实际检索且固定revision与hash的公开证据；完成后缩为已引用集合 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `provider_fingerprint` | `CHAR(64) NULL` | 配置endpoint及model和输出上限hash；不含密钥；改变后拒绝旧队列派发 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `reserved_tokens` | `BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` | 本请求尚未结算的保守token预留；未知结果保留，已结算归零 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `used_tokens` | `BIGINT NULL` | 供应商自报且通过边界校验的实际token总数；未确认时NULL | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `billing_state` | `VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL` | NONE无外部调用；RESERVED预留；SETTLED已结算；UNKNOWN结果未知；RELEASED确认未调用已释放 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `budget_date` | `DATE NOT NULL` | 本请求计入的UTC额度日期；结算不可转移日期 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `dispatched_at` | `DATETIME(3) NULL` | 派发外部HTTP前落盘的UTC标记；崩溃后不可盲重放 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `result_hash` | `CHAR(64) NULL` | 完整准入回答及引用与用量hash；同次不同内容的重复完成被拒绝 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |
| `completed_at` | `DATETIME(3) NULL` | 终态写入UTC时间；不冒充供应商实际完成时间 | `V004__tutor_runtime.sql` |

约束与索引：

```sql
PRIMARY KEY (request_id)
FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES tutor_request(id)
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES context_snapshot(workspace_id,id)
CHECK (mode IN ('EVIDENCE_ONLY','MODEL'))
CHECK (request_epoch>0 AND attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 3)
CHECK (reserved_tokens>=0 AND (used_tokens IS NULL OR used_tokens>=0))
CHECK (billing_state IN ('NONE','RESERVED','SETTLED','UNKNOWN','RELEASED'))
INDEX ix_tutor_runtime_lease (lease_until,request_id)
INDEX ix_tutor_runtime_workspace (workspace_id,request_id)
```

```sql
PRIMARY KEY (id)
FOREIGN KEY (suite_id,suite_revision) REFERENCES evaluation_suite_revision(suite_id,revision)
FOREIGN KEY (suite_id,owner_id,workspace_id,release_id) REFERENCES evaluation_suite(id,owner_id,workspace_id,release_id)
CHECK (top_k BETWEEN 1 AND 8)
CHECK (case_count BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND completed_cases BETWEEN 0 AND case_count)
CHECK (status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED'))
CHECK ((status='RUNNING' AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'RUNNING' AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL))
CHECK ((status='COMPLETED' AND metrics_json IS NOT NULL AND result_hash IS NOT NULL AND report_json IS NOT NULL AND report_hash IS NOT NULL AND report_bytes>0 AND completed_cases=case_count) OR (status<>'COMPLETED' AND metrics_json IS NULL AND result_hash IS NULL AND report_json IS NULL AND report_hash IS NULL AND report_bytes=0))
CHECK (report_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 2097152)
CHECK (result_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 1048576)
CHECK ((completed_cases=0 AND result_bytes=0) OR (completed_cases>0 AND result_bytes>0))
CHECK (status<>'QUEUED' OR completed_cases=0)
INDEX ix_evaluation_queue (status,created_at,id)
INDEX ix_evaluation_run_owner (owner_id,status,created_at)
INDEX ix_evaluation_run_suite (suite_id,id)
```

## import_batch — Private bounded batch document import and review lifecycle

创建于 `V014__batch_ingestion.sql`。

| 字段 | SQL 定义 | 用途 | 引入迁移 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | Private preview identity | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `source_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | Registered source; URLs are never fetched by this feature | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `owner_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | Authenticated active editor who supplied the files | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `revision` | `INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` | Compare-and-swap lifecycle revision | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `status` | `VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PREVIEW'` | PREVIEW COMMITTED CANCELLED EXPIRED | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `processing_note` | `VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL` | Editor supplied provenance and processing intent | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `created_at` | `DATETIME(3) NOT NULL` | Actual admission time UTC | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `expires_at` | `DATETIME(3) NOT NULL` | Uncommitted preview lifetime, twenty-four hours | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |

约束与索引：

```sql
PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE (id,source_id)
FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES knowledge_source(id)
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES app_user(id)
CHECK (revision > 0)
CHECK (status IN ('PREVIEW','COMMITTED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED'))
CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
INDEX ix_import_batch_owner (owner_id,created_at)
INDEX ix_import_batch_expiry (status,expires_at)
```

## import_batch_item — Per-file parsing results with upload hash and pinned capture lineage

创建于 `V014__batch_ingestion.sql`。

| 字段 | SQL 定义 | 用途 | 引入迁移 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | Stable per-file preview identity | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `batch_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | Owning private batch | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `source_id` | `CHAR(36) NOT NULL` | Same immutable registered source as the batch | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `ordinal_number` | `INT NOT NULL` | Preserves submitted file order | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `file_name` | `VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL` | Display name only; paths and control characters removed | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `media_type` | `VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL` | Actual supported extraction format or generic unrecognized file | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `byte_size` | `INT NOT NULL` | Actual uploaded byte count, at most one MiB | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `file_hash` | `CHAR(64) NOT NULL` | SHA256 of uploaded bytes; raw binary is not retained | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `original_hash` | `CHAR(64) NULL` | SHA256 of extracted normalized text | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `parser_version` | `VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL` | Actual deterministic extraction implementation | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `status` | `VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL` | READY FAILED COMMITTED SKIPPED | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `error_code` | `VARCHAR(64) NULL` | Stable safe per-file parser failure, never private parser details | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `message` | `VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL` | Extraction scope, limitations or safe error | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `original_markdown` | `MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL` | Preview text; removed at commit cancellation expiry or account closure | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `cleaned_markdown` | `MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL` | Initial or confirmed preview text; same retention as original | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |
| `capture_id` | `CHAR(36) NULL` | Actual immutable content_ingestion receipt after commit | `V014__batch_ingestion.sql` |

约束与索引：

```sql
PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE (batch_id,ordinal_number)
FOREIGN KEY (batch_id,source_id) REFERENCES import_batch(id,source_id)
FOREIGN KEY (source_id,capture_id) REFERENCES content_ingestion(source_id,id)
CHECK (ordinal_number >= 0 AND ordinal_number < 8)
CHECK (byte_size >= 0 AND byte_size <= 1048576)
CHECK (status IN ('READY','FAILED','COMMITTED','SKIPPED'))
CHECK ((status='COMMITTED' AND capture_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'COMMITTED' AND capture_id IS NULL))
CHECK ((status='FAILED' AND error_code IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'FAILED' AND error_code IS NULL))
```
